notes.title: Major Update ver. 0.40: Multi-trap system and new rules
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33709921/b5a7732b4515a11231dac152d1f48184e8a3ec7b.jpg[/img]
 
We encourage you to update the game to version 0.40 so there is no split of audience and everything work correctly in the game.
 
If you don't know how to update the game use link:  https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=2037-QEUH-3335
 
[b]UPDATE INCLUDES[/b]
 
[b]New multi-trap system[/b]
	- Traps will be combined in different ways and it will create interesting and difficult situations. The further you go up or down the building the more difficult and challenging rooms you will face.
	- Changed rules
	- New modifications of some traps

[b]Difficulties based on combined traps[/b]
	- You can choose preferable difficulty based on combined traps in private coop
	- You can choose damage multiplier in private coop
 
[b]Revival[/b]
	- You can revive your friends when you go to new floor or in some random rooms. This system will allow experienced players revive newbies so everyone could play together to the end
	- You can turn on or turn off revival in private coop
 
[b]Pyramidal maps[/b]
	- New pyramidal types of maps for coop game modes
	- You can choose pyramidal maps as well as cubical maps in private coop game mode
 
[b]Controller[/b]
	- Steam Controller and other controllers issues resolved (You will have to assign your inputs again)
	- All UI elements could be reached by controller
 
[b]Music[/b]
	- In-game Background ambient music
	- Main menu music volume slider in Audio Settings
	- In-game music volume slider in Audio Settings
 
[b]In-game events and messages[/b]
	- Motivational message in the middle of a Screen when you go to a new floor
	- Events in game are big and located in the upper center of the screen so you will not miss them
	- You will see events about someone's revival, finding the exit to new floor or final exit
	- Current count from 1 to max floor so you can see the progress
 
[b]Other improvements and fixes[/b]
	- Character Customization bug fixes (You will have to assign your clothes again after this Update)
	- Map generation random improved
	- In-game settings scrolling bug fix
	- Mouse disappearing rare bug fix
	- Rock column's physics improved
	- Others
 
[b]Language updates[/b]
	- Traditional Chinese Language Added (Special thanks to Ordic Cai)
	- Turkish Language Added (Special thanks to Ibrahim Çirkin)
	- Ukrainian Language Added (Special thanks to DreamMaker)
	- Greek Language Added (Special thanks to George Georgiou (George80s4ever))
	- Polish Language Added (Special thanks to Tymoteusz Barański (tymotylis))
	- Romanian Language Added (Special thanks to Codrin Rață)
	- Spanish Language Fixes (Special thanks to CIFUGAMES, Xomega820)
	- Russian Language Fixes
	- Little fix of Czech, German, Swedish
 
If you would like to translate the game to Finish, Arabic or Bulgarian write to us on room710games@gmail.com. We will add you in the Credits and give keys for you and your friends.
 
Thank you for your reviews and feedback! It means a lot to us!

notes.title: Do you think that HALF DEAD 2 is too easy? Update ver. 0.20
notes.notes:
We encourage you to update the game to version 0.20 so there is no split of audience.


If you don't know how to update the game use link:  https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=2037-QEUH-3335
 

Do you think HALF DEAD 2 is too easy?
	- Update the game to 0.20.
	- Choose Private or Singleplayer game mode
	- Use settings: difficulty - "Nightmare",  minimap - "Off", Size - "8x8x8".
 

Do you think that HALF DEAD 2 is too hard?
	- Update the game to 0.20.
	- Choose Private or Singleplayer game mode
	- Use settings: difficulty - "I'm too young to die",  minimap - "On"
 

Update ver. 0.20
	- Custom game mode renamed to private
	- Difficulties in private and singleplayer game modes
	- Minimap on/off setting in private and singleplayer game modes
	- Unnecessary waiting eliminated in private and singleplayer game modes
	- Running is still default but it's 20% faster
	- Doors do not close too often
	- Matchmaking - some nuances resolved. It will work more cool with joining with friends.
 
New languages:
Hungarian: Special thanks to Czimbalmos Hunor
Norwegian: Special thanks to Vebjørn Nyvoll


Comment us what you think we should do for the next Update!
